title: Crema Catalana
description: A traditional Spain dish made with whole cow milk, lemon zest, egg yolk, cornstarch. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Add the listed ingredients to the pot. Keep at a gentle simmer for about 8 minutes, until tender and cooked through.
Temper the yolks and starch mixture with hot aromatic milk, return to the saucepan and stir over gentle heat until thickened. Pour into shallow ramekins and chill.
Just before serving, sprinkle thinly with sugar and caramelize it using a kitchen torch or hot salamander to form a brittle crust.
